Definition: Jaazer or Jazer, a place East of the Jordan
BiblicalUsage: Moses sent to spy out Jaazer, and they took the villages thereof and drove out the Amorites. Jazer became Gad's, with all the cities of Gilead.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jazer matters because it was taken before it was given: Moses spied it out and Israel drove out its Amorites, and the land east of Jordan was won town by town before it was divided tribe by tribe.
